description: Prepare leaving a put to roll over by itself: gage's keeper rolls it in its last hours through its put router, at most maxCost each, buying each top-up with at most maxSpend of the wallet's USDG, up to four times. Leaves standing approvals to the put router. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

engine.description: The loan's core: its lend asset's (gage_capabilities lendAssets)

maxCost.description: The most each new loan may cost, its fixed cost and origination fee together, raw units of the loan's asset, at most the loan's principal; when omitted, as auto_roll starts it

maxSpend.description: The most of the pledge's token (USDG: 6 decimals) each roll may spend buying what the new loan leaves short, at most the loan's pledge; when omitted, twice what buying the largest top-up costs now

name: gage_prepare_put_auto_roll
title: Prepare: Roll a put over by itself
